cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('data.sqlite')
cur = conn.cursor()
cur.execute(\"SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'\")
tables = cur.fetchall()
print('Tables:', tables)
for t in tables:
    cur.execute(f'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [{t[0]}]')
    print(f'  {t[0]}: {cur.fetchone()[0]} rows')
    cur.execute(f'PRAGMA table_info([{t[0]}])')
    cols = cur.fetchall()
    for c in cols:
        print(f'    {c}')
conn.close()
"

cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('data.sqlite')
cur = conn.cursor()

print('=== reserve_components ===')
cur.execute('SELECT * FROM reserve_components')
rows = cur.fetchall()
for r in rows:
    print(r)

print()
print('=== reserve_components sum ===')
cur.execute('SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM reserve_components')
print(cur.fetchone())

print()
print('=== liability_inputs ===')
cur.execute('SELECT * FROM liability_inputs')
rows = cur.fetchall()
for r in rows:
    print(r)

conn.close()
"

cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('data.sqlite')
cur = conn.cursor()

# 1. reserve_assets_usd = SUM of all reserve_components
cur.execute('SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date = \"2025-06-30\"')
reserve_assets = cur.fetchone()[0]

# 2. net_token_liability_usd = gross contractual redemption - company-held tokens
cur.execute('SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN measure = \"gross contractual redemption\" THEN amount_usd ELSE 0 END) FROM liability_inputs')
gross = cur.fetchone()[0]
cur.execute('SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN measure = \"company-held tokens not in Treasury wallet\" THEN amount_usd ELSE 0 END) FROM liability_inputs')
held_tokens = cur.fetchone()[0]
net_token_liability = gross - held_tokens

# 3. company_asset_excess_usd = reserve_assets - detailed report company total liabilities
cur.execute('SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN measure = \"detailed FFR company total liabilities\" THEN amount_usd ELSE 0 END) FROM liability_inputs')
detailed_liability = cur.fetchone()[0]
company_asset_excess = reserve_assets - detailed_liability

# 4. release_liability_delta_usd = release amount - detailed report amount
cur.execute('SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN measure = \"July release company total liabilities\" THEN amount_usd ELSE 0 END) FROM liability_inputs')
release_liability = cur.fetchone()[0]
release_liability_delta = release_liability - detailed_liability

print(f'reserve_assets_usd: {reserve_assets}')
print(f'net_token_liability_usd: {net_token_liability}')
print(f'company_asset_excess_usd: {company_asset_excess}')
print(f'release_liability_delta_usd: {release_liability_delta}')
print(f'Detailed: {detailed_liability}')
print(f'Release: {release_liability}')
print(f'Difference: {release_liability - detailed_liability}')

conn.close()
"
